text: Hello Abbu, it's Ayesha. How are you today?
Not so good, beta. I slipped in the bathroom this morning and fell down.
Oh no, Abbu. Are you hurt?
My hip hurts a lot and I can hardly stand up. I hit my head on the sink also.
That worries me. Is anyone with you at home?
No, I am alone. I am lying on the sofa now, I cannot walk properly.
Please stay still, I will make sure someone comes.
Yes, please. It hurts very much.
